title: The creator of Claude Code just shared his top 5 tips
description:
The creator of Claude Code just shared his top 5 tips for getting better results in Claude.

The biggest shift?

Don’t just ask Claude to build something and hope it works.

Give it a feedback loop so it can build, check, find issues, fix them, and re-check.

Then use Plan Mode for complex tasks, parallel sessions to run multiple tasks at once, and project rules so Claude learns from its mistakes.

This is how power users get much better results from Claude Code.
